001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
006import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
007import com.streamconverter.path.IPath;
008import java.io.IOException;
009import java.io.InputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStream;
011import java.util.List;
012
013/**
014 * JSON Filter Command Class
015 *
016 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from JSON using TreePath expressions. Unlike
017 * JsonWalker which applies transformations, JsonFilterCommand only extracts/filters data based on
018 * specified paths without any modifications.
019 *
020 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using TreePath expressions - Preserve exact data types
021 * and structure of extracted elements - Streaming processing via Jackson Streaming API
022 * (JsonParser/JsonGenerator); the document is never fully loaded into memory - Support for simple
023 * path expressions including wildcards ($[*].field, $.array[*].nested.field)
024 */
025public class JsonFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
026
027  private final IPath<List<String>> jsonPath;
028  private final JsonFactory jsonFactory;
029
030  /**
031   * Constructor for JSON filtering with typed TreePath selector.
032   *
033   * @param jsonPath the typed TreePath to extract data
034   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
035   */
036  private JsonFilterCommand(IPath<List<String>> jsonPath) {
037    this.jsonPath = jsonPath;
038    this.jsonFactory = new JsonFactory();
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Factory method for JSON filtering with typed path selector.
043   *
044   * @param jsonPath the typed path to extract data
045   * @return a JsonFilterCommand instance
046   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
047   */
048  public static JsonFilterCommand create(IPath<List<String>> jsonPath) {
049    if (jsonPath == null) {
050      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
051    }
052    return new JsonFilterCommand(jsonPath);
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
057    List<PathSegment> segments = JsonPathParser.parse(jsonPath.toString());
058
059    try (JsonParser parser = jsonFactory.createParser(inputStream);
060        JsonGenerator generator = jsonFactory.createGenerator(outputStream)) {
061      generator.disable(JsonGenerator.Feature.AUTO_CLOSE_TARGET);
062
063      if (segments.isEmpty()) {
064        JsonValueCopier.copyValue(parser, generator);
065      } else {
066        JsonPathExtractor.extractPath(parser, generator, segments, 0);
067      }
068
069      generator.flush();
070    }
071  }
072}
